feed.text: Post, comment and react with real classmates from your university. All content goes through moderation before it is shown.
feed.s1: Sign up with your institutional email and confirm a code.
feed.s2: Follow classmates and join study groups by subject.

events.alt: Preview of an event with the registration confirmed
events.title: Register in seconds
events.text: Reserve your seat at workshops and talks by paying with credits. See the available seats in real time.
events.s1: Pick an event and check the date, venue and seats.
events.s2: Confirm with your credits: you are charged once, even if you tap twice.

wallet.title: Your credits, always clear
wallet.text: Top up, check your balance and review every transaction. Every operation is safe and never charged twice.
wallet.s1: Top up with packages of 20, 50 or 100 credits.
wallet.s2: If you cancel in time or a registration fails, you are refunded automatically.
wallet.s3: Full history of top-ups, payments and refunds.

publish.alt: Preview of the QR ticket attendees receive
publish.title: Publish and get paid without spreadsheets
publish.text: Create your event with seats and a price in credits. Registrations and payments reconcile themselves and every attendee gets a ticket.
publish.s1: Set the date, venue, seats and price.
publish.s2: Charge in credits: no more reconciling transfers by hand.
publish.s3: Every registrant receives a signed QR ticket.

scan.alt: Preview of the organizer's ticket scanner
scan.title: Validate tickets at the door
scan.text: Scan each attendee's QR with your phone. Every ticket can only be used once.
scan.s1: Open the scanner and point at the ticket's QR.
scan.s2: Validation is instant and catches repeated tickets.
scan.s3: Only the event's organizer can validate.

moderation.alt: Preview of the moderation panel with flagged content
moderation.title: A well-kept community
moderation.text: The moderation team reviews flagged or reported content from a panel and decides in seconds, with live updates.
moderation.s1: Community reports land in a single queue.
moderation.s2: Every item shows the reasons and who reported it.
moderation.s3: Keep or remove, and suspend the author if needed.

faq.title: What people ask us the most
faq.a1: Students with an institutional email from an enabled university. That way only real people from your community are inside the network.
faq.a2: Signing up and using the network is free. You only pay, with credits from your wallet, for events that have a price; free events cost nothing.
faq.a3: You top up credits in your wallet and use them to register for events. If a registration fails or you cancel in time, the charge is refunded automatically.
faq.q4: How do I get into an event?
faq.a4: When you register you get a ticket with a QR code in the app. The organizer scans it at the door and your attendance is recorded.
faq.a5: Anyone can report a post. The moderation team reviews it from the panel and can hide or approve it.
faq.q6: Is there an English version and dark mode?
faq.a6: Yes. Bandada U is available in Spanish and English and has light and dark mode, automatic or your choice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Bandada U processes, what it uses it for and what rights you have over it. Bandada U is an academic project for the Software Engineering II course (Group 24).
privacy.s1Body: Institutional email, name, university, program, semester and interests that you provide; the content you post; your registrations, tickets and credit transactions; and the minimum technical data needed to run the service, such as your preferred language and theme.
privacy.s2Title: What we use your data for
privacy.s2Body: To verify your identity as a student, show you your feed and groups, manage your registrations and wallet, send you service notifications and keep the platform safe and moderated.
privacy.s3Body: We do not sell your data. Event organizers only see the data needed to manage your registration. The moderation team may review reported content.
privacy.s4Body: This site stores only your language and theme preferences in your browser, to remember them. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s5Body: You can access your data, correct it or ask for its deletion by contacting the project team. We will handle your request within a reasonable time.
privacy.s6Body: If we update this policy, we will publish the new version on this page with its update date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using Bandada U you accept these terms. Bandada U is an academic project for the Software Engineering II course (Group 24), and the service is provided as is.
terms.s1Body: You need an institutional email from an enabled university. You are responsible for the security of your account and the accuracy of your data.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for what you post. Illegal, violent or sexually explicit content, harassment and impersonation are not allowed. We may hide content and suspend accounts that break these rules.
terms.s3Body: Credits are used to register for events within the platform. If a registration cannot be completed or is cancelled within the event's deadline, the charge is refunded in credits. In this version, credit top-ups are simulated.
terms.s4Body: We do our best to keep the service available, but we do not guarantee it will run without interruptions or errors.
terms.s5Body: The Bandada U brand and software belong to their authors. You keep the rights to the content you post and allow us to display it within the platform.
terms.s6Body: We may update these terms. If you keep using the service after an update, you accept it.

about.title: We bring university life together in one place
about.subtitle: Bandada U comes from an everyday problem: announcements, events and payments at university are scattered across many channels. We want to bring them into one verified community.
about.teaserTitle: A community made by and for students
about.teaserSubtitle: Find out what drives us, how we work and who is behind Bandada U.
about.missionShort: Connect students in a verified, academic space that works even with a poor connection.
about.missionBody: Connect the students of a university in a single verified, academic space where they can communicate, organize, sign up for events and pay with confidence, even on an unstable connection.
about.visionShort: Be the go-to social network for university life, with no scattered groups or hand-reconciled payments.
about.visionBody: Be the go-to social network for university life: every student can find out, take part and sign up for what happens on campus without relying on scattered groups or hand-reconciled payments.
about.valuesSubtitle: Principles that show in the product and in the way we build it.

values.communityBody: Real students only: you sign in with your institutional email and a verification code.
values.trustBody: A charge is applied only once and, if a registration fails midway, the credit returns to your wallet.
values.offlineBody: Read the feed and prepare your posts even when the network fails; everything syncs without duplicates when you are back online.
values.careBody: Content is reviewed with the help of artificial intelligence and human moderators.
values.inclusiveBody: Available in Spanish and English, with light and dark modes and designed to be accessible.
values.rigorBody: Documented requirements and contracts, automated tests and recorded design decisions.

about.projectTitle: An academic project with a product mindset
about.projectBody: Bandada U is the Software Engineering II project. We design and build it end to end: mobile and web app, admin panel and cloud services.
about.teamSubtitle: The people who design, build and maintain Bandada U.
